title: Nagantaka Prime
extract:
Nagantaka Prime is the Primed variant of the  Nagantaka Crossbow, sporting increased Damage, Critical Chance, burst Fire rate, and Magazine size. It was released alongside  Garuda Prime and  Corvas Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals mostly  Slash damage.
Headshot kills from direct bolt damage boosts reload speed by 50%.
Guaranteed  Impact proc.
Guaranteed  Impact proc may make it hard to land consecutive headshots to trigger its passive.
Alternate Fire shoots all remaining ammunition in the magazine in a quick burst, at approximately 2.3 times its listed standard Fire Rate.
Benefits from magazine increasing mods to further increase the burst's damage.
Abilities can be cast during the burst without interrupting it. However, Stagger effects such as a self-stagger from a  Thunderbolt explosion will interrupt the burst.
Innate 1 meter Punch Through if used by  Garuda or Garuda Prime
On kill, bodies will follow the arrow that killed them, damaging anyone in their path and pinning the corpse to walls.
Counts as a bow in regards to fire rate mods, doubling the fire rate bonus.
Can use the bow-exclusive  Thunderbolt mod.

Acquisition

Notes
When used by  Garuda or  Garuda Prime, the Nagantaka Prime gains 1 meter innate Punch Through.
Similar to its standard counterpart, the Nagantaka Prime's Alternate Fire will eject all of the remaining ammunition in the magazine in a single burst.
If buffed with unlimited ammo such as from the Reactant Buff, the weapon will only fire its magazine amount at a time, with small delays between each trigger pull.
Unlike  the  Pandero or   Wild Frenzy, the Nagantaka Prime can still be aimed during the burst, allowing the weapon to still benefit from Acolyte Mods. However, recoil can be a bit of an issue when trying to aim the entire burst at a single target especially if   Speed Trigger is used, so you may need to equip   Stabilizer to account for it.
Given the much higher damage-per-shot of the Nagantaka Prime compared to other Burst and Auto rifles and its own standard counterpart, while in mid-burst the Nagantaka Prime has a higher total DPS rate than all of them.

Tips
As with most weapons with the ability to unload an entire magazine in a single burst (such as the  Kuva Hek or the  Pandero), the Nagantaka Prime's alt-fire synergizes well with  Mag's short-tap  Magnetize bubble, as the quick torrent of shot can pulverize crowds of enemies caught in the bubble.
Due to the weapon possessing 90% slash damage, mods such as Fanged Fusillade are highly effective on it, providing more damage bonus than pure 90% elemental mods.

Bugs
Alt fire is not silent and will alert enemies if fired, but will not break  Prowl's cloak.
